label: sequence drill down
prompt:
Inspect the implemented codebase and extract detailed sequence data for the selected item: "{{parent-node}}".

Locate runtime interaction corresponding to selected label.

If selected item represents a participant, extract a representative interaction showing how its internal collaborators perform its responsibility.

If selected item represents a message, trace that operation from sender to receiver, including delegated calls, responses, asynchronous events, persistence operations, and external interactions.

Keep scope centered on selected item. Store messages in chronological order. Include alternative, optional, or repeated sections when verified in implementation.

Set data type to sequence. Use consistent participant abstraction and stable semantic identifiers for participants, messages, fragments, and regions.

Return only semantic JSON data required by appended diagram-data contract. Do not generate SVG, HTML, Mermaid, styling, or visual layout. Let application calculate participant positions and message placement.
